# ISyrupRouter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/syrup/ISyrupRouter.sol)

**Title:**
ISyrupRouter

Interface for the Maple Syrup deposit router


## Functions
### authorizeAndDeposit

Authorizes and deposits assets into the Vault.


```solidity
function authorizeAndDeposit(
    uint256 bitmap_,
    uint256 deadline_,
    uint8 auth_v,
    bytes32 auth_r,
    bytes32 auth_s,
    uint256 amount_,
    bytes32 depositData_
)
    external
    returns (uint256 shares_);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bitmap_`|`uint256`|     The bitmap of the permission.|
|`deadline_`|`uint256`|   The timestamp after which the `authorize` signature is no longer valid.|
|`auth_v`|`uint8`|      ECDSA signature v component.|
|`auth_r`|`bytes32`|      ECDSA signature r component.|
|`auth_s`|`bytes32`|      ECDSA signature s component.|
|`amount_`|`uint256`|     The amount of assets to deposit.|
|`depositData_`|`bytes32`|Optional deposit data.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares_`|`uint256`|     The amount of shares minted.|


### deposit

Mints `shares` to sender by depositing `assets` into the Vault.


```solidity
function deposit(uint256 assets, bytes32 depositData) external returns (uint256 shares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|     The amount of assets to deposit.|
|`depositData`|`bytes32`|Optional deposit data.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|     The amount of shares minted.|


### nonces

Returns the next nonce for the owner's signature.


```solidity
function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|The address to check the nonce for.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The next nonce.|


### poolPermissionManager

Returns the address of the pool permission manager.


```solidity
function poolPermissionManager() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The pool permission manager address.|


## Events
### DepositData
Optional Deposit Data for off-chain processing.


```solidity
event DepositData(address indexed owner, uint256 amount, bytes32 depositData);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|      The receiver of the shares.|
|`amount`|`uint256`|     The amount of assets to deposit.|
|`depositData`|`bytes32`|Optional deposit data.|
